title: ∂[[E]] is a cycle: ∂∂[[E]] = 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, E ⊆ ℝ^P, let ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) be arbitrary, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy T(ω) = ∫_E ⟨dω, ξ_N⟩ dH^{n+1} for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξ_N). Then ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T; for n = 0 this is Simon's convention ∂T = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → BoundaryVanishes T
